requests.prompt: Design reference sheet for SYDNEY, an adult cyber-ghost bride boss in a dark 2D pixel-art platform game. She must read as a haunting bride, not a nun, angel, robot, child or cute mascot. Front view, locked camera, upper-left light, stylized adult proportions about four heads tall. Design for a 74-pixel-tall figure inside a 96x96 sprite: arched bridal veil surrounding dark violet hair masses, a small pale face with narrow unsettling eyes, fitted ivory bodice and an A-line wedding skirt dissolving into three tapered wavy ghost tails with no feet. Two delicate arms with clear negative space beside the body. Controlled cloth folds, selective one-pixel dark cool outline, large coherent hard pixel clusters; no gradients, anti-aliasing, bloom or fuzzy transparency. Palette roles: dark hair/outline #2c2330 #34354f #575c79; cool shadows #858eb0; veil #9dded1 #d9ffea; ivory dress and pale face #f5e8c8 #cbb696; sparse corruption accents #723f68 #eaa083 and tiny #e5c386. Never use #d97757, reserved for the hero. Exactly THREE equal panels in ONE horizontal row, equal spacing, identical character scale, centered pivot and bottom height. All three are the SAME bride in the same neutral floating pose with hands lowered beside the waist. Left: calm but possessive dialogue phase, ivory/mint dress and veil, closed small mouth. Middle: sharper eyes and expression, a few angular cyan seams, still unmistakably the same bridal costume. Right: hostile digital-ghost phase, limited plum and cyan pixel fissures across the face and skirt, slightly fragmented hem, but KEEP the same white wedding dress, veil and body proportions. Do not add props, weapons, projectiles, text bubbles, scenery, shadow circles, halos, crosses, flowers, wings, labels, text, borders or watermarks. Flat plain #808080 background. This is a consistent design sheet, not a finished game asset.
